title: MedAtlas Austria: overview film
description: Medicines and shortages, from the public registers. A narrated tour of the MedAtlas Austria demo, figures as of 4 November 2026, with English captions. Not medical advice.
alt: Overview film, 64 seconds: MedAtlas Austria, independent research on medicine shortages in Austria. Substance finder, next steps, the nightly data report with 622 active shortages as of 4 November 2026, the 24-month chart, the top reasons and alerts. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: A child has a fever. The pharmacy says: not available.
MedAtlas shows what is short, and what has the same substance.
Search a substance, grouped by availability.
Then call a pharmacy, and let doctor or pharmacist decide.
622 shortages, 287 substances, one package in three not deliverable.
Counted every night: 133 new reports in October alone.
Top reason: manufacturing delays. Median planned outage: 272 days.
Alerts tell you when it is back.
MedAtlas. Open data, no medical advice.
